implementation: Actual successful root board-preparation worker checks explicit observation selector and schedules the real retained startup worker through the existing composition lock and shared one-attempt latch.
Minimal factory takes only actual platform,root,prepared topology/code owners. It constructs no full GPU StartupInputs26 or successful authority callbacks.
Observation branch retains prepared prefix and creates read intent on its own read worker;no workloop or full-startup hardware callbacks are needed or consumed.
Original thread submission body is factored once and shared. Submission returned/raw is independently queryable;terminal observations still require completed worker status.
limitations: Future reviewed fresh packet must select the observation and capture its actual terminal result in native log;existing v16 packet remains consumed.
No device/native/mapping/read/decoder execution or stable firmware qualification.
